title: Server patching
desc: Check for and apply OS package updates (apt, dnf, yum, apk). Reboots are never automatic.
upToDate: Your server is up to date.
checkFailed: The update check couldn't complete — a package repository may be unreachable or misconfigured. This is not the same as being up to date.
unsupported: Automatic patching needs one of apt, dnf, yum or apk on the server.
rebootRequired: A reboot is required to finish applying updates.
agentDesc: Update the Tugra agent to the latest signed release. The hub picks a digest-pinned image from its verified release manifest; the agent reconnects on the new version.
agentConfirm: Update the Tugra agent on this server? It restarts on the new signed version and reconnects automatically.
agentSent: Update dispatched — the agent reconnects on the new version shortly.
agentOffline: The agent is offline — try again once it reconnects.
agentNoDigest: No signed image is available for this server's architecture.
agentCapability: The deploy capability isn't granted to this server's agent.
agentNotPermitted: You don't have permission to update this server's agent.
agentUnconfigured: Agent updates aren't configured on this hub (no signed release manifest).
agentError: Couldn't verify the latest signed release.
